Things to do

The list state lives in the URL. Add, complete, edit, filter, delete, and share tasks while the Activity panel shows the event payload.

    Connection

    Use a browser project API key. The app disables automatic tracking so the Activity panel only contains the events in this exercise.

    The project API key is intended for client-side use. It stays in this browser tab and is kept out of the URL, so a share link never carries it. Don't enter a secret key, email address, task contents, or other private data.

    Session Replay and Web Experiment

    Session Replay records the page, so masking is instrumentation too. This app runs the conservative privacy level and marks the task list amp-mask, which means replays show the shape of what somebody did without the words they typed.

    Workshop profile

    Instrumentation plan

    This plan came with the app. Somebody instrumented it in a hurry and moved on. Rename events, tick the properties each event needs, drop the ones you can't justify, fix any type that's wrong, and untick an action you decided not to track at all.

    Task text is never sent to Amplitude. Length and age support the exercise questions without collecting what somebody typed.

    User properties

    These are sent with the Identify call in the Connection panel, not with each event.

    Activity

    Preview payloads appear before connection. Once connected you also get Wire entries, which are the events as they actually leave the browser: session, replay ID, and anything a plugin added.
